brand.name: AcademiaHub Smart Campus
brand.tagline: The Ultimate Student Portal & Question Paper Repository
brand.theme: Dual Theme (Dark Obsidian Navy default / Crisp Academic Light)

rules: Headings MUST use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). NEVER use Inter for titles.
Body text MUST use 'DM Sans' with relaxed line height (leading-relaxed).
Codes, Subject Codes (e.g., CS8391), Paper IDs and Dates MUST use 'JetBrains Mono'.
H1 ceiling is text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with font-extrabold.
Labels & Badges MUST be uppercase with wider tracking (tracking-wider or tracking-widest text-xs font-semibold).

contrast_rules: Never use pure black #000000 or plain transparent background without blur backdrop.
All text on dark backgrounds MUST have a minimum 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio.
Interactive states MUST explicitly define text colors, e.g., hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white.
FORBIDDEN COLORS: Do NOT use #7351B7 or #1B93A4.

navigation_structure.desktop: Top fixed navbar with glassmorphism blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b), containing Logo, Search Trigger, Theme Toggle, Bookmark Quick Drawer, Admin Button, and User Profile menu.
navigation_structure.mobile: Sticky glass header top + Fixed Floating Bottom Navigation Bar (Home, Papers Hub, Timetable, Planner, Analytics, Admin if role=admin) with active pill indicator.
navigation_structure.layout_wrapper: Max width container (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6), responsive padding.

bento_grid_patterns.home_dashboard: Tetris Grid: Hero welcome widget (col-span-full lg:col-span-8), Quick Stats (col-span-4), Upcoming Exams Widget (col-span-4), Recent Question Papers Carousel (col-span-8), Quick Action Dock.
bento_grid_patterns.question_paper_hub: Multi-tier Drilldown Matrix: Top Breadcrumbs & Filter Bar -> Department Cards Grid (6 cards with custom gradients and icons) -> Year & Semester Selector Tabs -> Subject Cards Grid -> Exam Type Pills & Year Chips -> Paper Grid Cards with Quick Action Bar.

question_paper_hub.drilldown_hierarchy: Department (IT, CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil) -> Academic Year (e.g. 2025-2026) -> Class/Year (1st Year, 2nd Year, 3rd Year, 4th Year) -> Semester (Sem 1 to Sem 8) -> Subject (e.g. DBMS, OS, AI, Networks) -> Exam Type (Internal 1, Internal 2, Internal 3, Model Exam, Practical Exam, Semester Exam) -> Exam Year (2025, 2024, 2023...) -> Paper Document Card
question_paper_hub.paper_card_elements: Subject code badge, exam type pill, clearly highlighted EXAM YEAR tag (e.g. '2025'), page count, file type badge (PDF/Image), solution included toggle, view preview button, instant download button, bookmark toggle button.
question_paper_hub.preview_modal: Fullscreen or high-density Dialog displaying mock PDF viewer with zoom controls, page navigator, paper details sidebar, download button, print button, and related papers recommendation.

smart_timetable.design: Day-by-day interactive horizontal schedule rail (Mon-Sat) with ongoing class countdown, room allocation badges, faculty info, and period status pills (Upcoming, In Progress, Completed).

study_planner.design: Kanban & Calendar hybrid with task priorities (High, Medium, Low), target dates, exam countdown badges, progress indicators, and task creation dialog.

exam_schedule.design: Timeline view with countdown timers (Days, Hours, Minutes), hall ticket location, syllabus topics coverage checklist, and exam guidelines toggle.

student_progress.design: Recharts visual dashboard showing Subject GPA/Marks breakdown, Semester performance trend charts, and strengths/weaknesses breakdown.

admin_paper_upload.design: Non-generic admin studio card modal/page featuring step-by-step drag-and-drop file upload (PDF/JPG/PNG), metadata selectors (Department, Academic Year, Class/Year, Semester, Subject, Exam Type, Exam Year, Regulations), and paper approval manager.

image_urls.description: Student studying in a modern academic library surrounded by books and laptop.
Large high-ceiling university library with bright illumination.
Students collaborating in a clean contemporary campus area.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Build all React components using .js files since the project setup relies on JavaScript.
Always wrap interactive elements with proper framer-motion micro-animations (whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}, whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}).
Ensure dark mode and light mode toggle works seamlessly using next-themes or a class-based documentElement toggle.

Implement realistic mock PDF/Image rendering inside the Paper Preview dialog with full sample question paper text content (Header, Subject Code, Time: 3 Hrs, Marks: 100, Part A, Part B, Part C questions).
Include local storage persistence for Bookmarks, Study Planner tasks, and User authentication state.
Avoid standard administrative generic tables. Use custom styled cards, status badges, clean visual progress bars, and rich micro-details.
